'''Martin Bodo Plenio''' (born 20 May 1968) is a German [[physicist]], [[Alexander von Humboldt Professor]], and Director of the Institute for Theoretical Physics at [[Ulm University]].

He is notable for his work on entanglement theory, quantum technology, hyperpolarisation methods and [[quantum biology]].

== Education ==

He obtained his Diploma 1992 and Doctorate 1994 in [[physics]] from the [[University of Göttingen]].

== Career ==

In 1995 – 1997, he was a Feodor Lynen Fellow at [[Imperial College|Imperial College London]] in the group of Prof. Sir. Peter Knight FRS. He was Lecturer (1998–2001), Senior Lecturer (2001–2003) and Full Professor (2003–2009) at [[Imperial College|Imperial College London]]. In 2009 he was awarded an Alexander von Humboldt Professorship<ref>[http://www.humboldt-foundation.de/web/ahp-2009-en.html Alexander von Humboldt Professur 2009]</ref> of the [[Alexander von Humboldt Foundation]] and moved to [[University of Ulm|Ulm University]] where he is Director of the Institute of Theoretical Physics<ref name=sudwest>{{cite news|last=Mayer|first=Christoph|title=Zusage mit Vorbehalt|url=http://www.suedwest-aktiv.de/region/swp_neuulm/ulm_und_neu_ulm/3964816/artikel.php?SWAID=6066a7b921f8470b5ccf3e0aff57ab82|access-date=28 July 2013|newspaper=Südwest Presse|date=14 November 2008}}</ref><ref name=focus>{{cite news|title=Martin Bodo Plenio, Quantenphysiker|url=http://www.focus.de/wissen/mensch/tid-12137/wissenschaftspreis-martin-bodo-plenio-quantenphysiker_aid_340943.html|access-date=28 July 2013|newspaper=Focus}}</ref> and leads the Controlled Quantum Dynamics group.<ref>[http://www.qubit-ulm.com Controlled Quantum Dynamics Group, Institute of Theoretical Physics, Ulm University]</ref> He held a part-time position at [[Imperial College|Imperial College London]].<ref>[http://www.imperial.ac.uk/AP/faces/pages/read/Home.jsp?person=m.plenio Staff Home Page Imperial College London]</ref> He was awarded successive European Research Council Synergy in 2012 and in 2019. In 2016 he co-founded NVision Imaging Technologies <ref>https://www.nvision-imaging.com/</ref> a technology company that is leveraging advances in quantum physics to enable the first routine, convenient and affordable use of Magnetic Resonance Imaging for assessing early patient response to cancer treatment at the metabolic level. In 2021 he co-founded QC Design <ref>https://www.qc.design/</ref> that is providing design automation software for the development of fault tolerant quantum computing devices.

In 2014 he was awarded €27Million for a research building to establish the Center for Quantum Biosciences of which he is the founding director.<ref> [[:de:Forschungsbau|Forschungsbau an der Universität Ulm]]</ref> The center promotes research at the interface between quantum science and technology and the life sciences.
